Investment & Plans — Care that honors your pace

I meet people where they are: practical, compassionate, and grounded. Below are the core ways I support clients. If a plan here doesn’t fit your situation, we can shape something together.

Sessions are informed by {{MODALITIES}}. {{THERAPIST_NAME}}, {{LICENSE}}, offers individual work in {{CITY}}, {{STATE}} and remote sessions where permitted.

{{PRIMARY_CTA_LABEL}}

How I begin — A gentle diagnostic

At our first meeting we use a structured intake to understand immediate needs, safety planning, and strengths. Typical topics: current symptoms, relational stressors, sleep, substance use, and any prior therapy history. This is collaborative — you set the pace.

Pathways & Planning

From assessment we co-design a pathway. Some people choose focused short-term work; others prefer ongoing weekly sessions. I emphasize measurable, compassionate goals and reassess regularly.

Short-Term Support

$150 / session

6–12 sessions. Best for focused goals: transitions, problem-solving, skill-building.

Small practices that amplify sessions

Micro-habits I often give between sessions: a two-minute grounding ritual, a brief somatic check-in each morning, and a journaling prompt focused on noticing strengths. These are optional and adapted to your needs.

Payment, insurance, and accessibility

I accept major credit cards and secure payment platforms. I am not a provider for all insurance networks; I can provide a superbill for out-of-network reimbursement upon request. Sliding scale spots are limited — please inquire.

Pricing is subject to change. A canceled session with less than 24 hours notice may incur a fee.

Ready to begin?

If you'd like to talk about fit, schedule a 20-minute consultation. We'll clarify goals and practical details.

{{PRIMARY_CTA_LABEL}}

Confidentiality, scope & crisis information

Therapy is confidential except where disclosure is required by law (e.g., imminent risk of harm to self or others, suspected abuse). I do not provide emergency services. If you are in crisis, call emergency services or your local crisis line. Sessions are therapeutic and supportive; they are not a substitute for emergency medical care.

All clinical notes are stored securely. Please contact {{EMAIL}} with questions about privacy or record requests.

Questions I often hear — brief, plain answers

Below are practical clarifications to help you decide whether to reach out. These are not exhaustive; if your question isn’t listed, contact me at {{EMAIL}}.

What happens in a first session?
We focus on safety, your immediate concerns, and a short assessment of goals and history. Expect to discuss what prompted you to seek support and any current risks. We conclude with practical next steps and a clear plan if we choose to continue.
How long will I need therapy?
There is no set timeline. Some clients work together for a few months to address a specific transition. Others engage in longer-term work. We set goals and review progress regularly; you decide when to scale back. If you seek short-term symptom relief, I may offer targeted interventions; for deeper relational patterns, longer work is often more effective.
Do you work with insurance?
I can provide a superbill that you may submit to your insurer for out-of-network reimbursement when allowed. I am not in-network with every plan. Payment is accepted by card or secure transfer. Sliding scale availability is limited — please ask.
Is online therapy available?
Yes, I offer telehealth sessions to clients in {{STATE}} and other jurisdictions where I am licensed. For out-of-state clients, I will confirm licensure rules before scheduling. If you need help with a technical setup, I will provide simple instructions.
What if I'm in crisis?
I do not provide emergency services. If you are in imminent danger or are a clear risk to yourself or others, call 911 or your local emergency number. If you’re having suicidal thoughts but are not in immediate danger, consider calling your local crisis line or the national crisis hotline in your country.
How do you protect my privacy?
Clinical notes and communications are stored securely and are disclosed only in accordance with law and ethical obligations (e.g., risk of harm, court order). For specifics about record requests and retention, contact {{EMAIL}}.
What modalities do you use?
I draw from {{MODALITIES}} and integrate somatic, relational, and mindfulness-informed practices. Treatment is individualized and collaborative.
Do you offer brief tools between sessions?
Yes. I often suggest micro-habits: short breathing practices, reflective prompts, or movement breaks tailored to your rhythm. These are optional and designed to support session work.
Schedule a brief consult

If you prefer, call {{PHONE}} or email {{EMAIL}}.

Scope, consent & limits

Therapy is a confidential, voluntary process. I do not provide forensic assessments or emergency services. If your needs fall outside my scope, I will help connect you to appropriate resources. By initiating services you consent to treatment within discussed limits.
